description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security 

 At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.  

 Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures. 
Remote Location Mexico SUMMARY: 
 
 We are seeking a Software Developer - Product Configuration to design, build, support, and enhance our product configurator platforms (Experlogix and V6) and their integrations with ERP and other enterprise systems. This hands-on technical role blends application development, integration work, and operational support. The developer will work closely with business users, product modelers, other IT teams, and vendors to translate requirements into reliable solutions, diagnose and resolve production issues, and deliver configuration and integration improvements. 
 
 Required Skills and Competencies 
 
 Self-motivated with the ability to establish priorities and effectively manage time to complete multiple tasks within specified time frames 
 Ability to communicate well verbally and in writing, with various team members across the globe in roles that are both technical and non-technical 
 Be willing to coordinate efforts with employees including internal stakeholders, other technology teams, external suppliers/consultants, service providers, etc. 
 Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements 
 Strong administrative and organization skills with attention to detail and sense of urgency 
 
 Job Duties and Responsibilities 
 
 Develop and maintain custom features, scripts, and integrations for Experlogix and V6 product configuration platforms. 
 Design, build, and consume RESTful APIs and other web services to integrate configurators with ERPs and in-house systems. 
 Implement HTML/JavaScript-based UI pieces or client-side customizations as required by product configuration workflows. 
 Write C#/.NET code for back-end services, extensions, and integration components. 
 Use SQL (MS SQL Server / Azure SQL) to author queries, stored procedures, and troubleshoot data issues related to configuration and integrations. 
 Leverage basic cloud services and patterns (Azure preferred) for hosting, integration, automation, or scaling (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus). 
 Support operational health: monitor logs, triage incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate remediation across teams and vendors. 
 Work with vendors to report defects, validate vendor fixes, test patches in non-production environments, and deploy solutions. 
 Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implement configuration or code changes; create and maintain technical design documents and runbooks. 
 Participate in release activities, coordinate with infrastructure/DBA/security teams, and follow SDLC and CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps preferred). 
 Proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, deployment automation, and operational efficiency. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related STEM field (or equivalent experience), required. 
 3+ years of professional experience developing, supporting, or implementing enterprise applications, CPQ/configurator solutions, or ERP integrations. 
 Hands-on development experience in .Net, C#, JavaScript, and HTML. 
 Experience designing and building SOAP or RESTful APIs and consuming web services. 
 Demonstrable proficiency with MS SQL Server / Azure SQL (writing T-SQL, troubleshooting data flows). 
 Familiarity with cloud concepts and experience with Azure services or equivalent cloud platforms. 
 Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to dig into logs and code to determine root causes. 
 Experience with Microsoft Dynamics (AX/365) or other ERP systems and integration patterns (OData, DMF, SOAP), plus. 
 Experience with PowerShell or other scripting languages for automation and operational tasks. 
 Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps. 
 We Celebrate Who We Are!  
 Allegion is committed to building and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Together, we embrace all differences and similarities among colleagues, as well as the differences and similarities within the relationships that we foster with customers, suppliers and the communities where we live and work. Whatever your background, experience, race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender, gender identity, disability status, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law, we will make sure that you have every opportunity to impress us in your application and the opportunity to give your best at work, not because we’re required to, but because it’s the right thing to do.   We are also committed to providing accommodations for persons with disabilities. If for any reason you cannot apply through our career site and require an accommodation or assistance, please contact our Talent Acquisition Team .
